question.:question/problem:
What is the sum of the leading entries of the $1\text{st},$ $2\text{nd},$ and $3\text{rd}$ rows in the matrix $A,$ given below?

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}7 & 5 & 9 & -7 \\ 8 & 2 & 8 & -8 \\ -5 & 8 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & -8 & -2\end{bmatrix}
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The first non-zero entry of each row (from left to right) is the leading entry. 

Therefore, the leading entries of the $1\text{st},$ $2\text{nd},$ and $3\text{rd}$ rows of $A$ are $7,$ $8,$ and $-5$, respectively.

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}7 & 5 & 9 & -7 \\ 8 & 2 & 8 & -8 \\ -5 & 8 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & -8 & -2\end{bmatrix}
$$

So, the answer is $7+8+(-5)=10.$

What is the sum of the leading entries of the $1\text{st}$ and $4\text{th}$ rows in the matrix $A,$ given below?

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}4 & 3 & 4 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 9 & -6 \\ -6 & 2 & 6 & 2 \\ 0 & -4 & -7 & -2\end{bmatrix}
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The first non-zero entry of each row (from left to right) is the leading entry. 

Therefore, the leading entries of the $1\text{st}$ and $4\text{th}$ rows of $A$ are $4$ and $-4$, respectively.

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}4 & 3 & 4 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 9 & -6 \\ -6 & 2 & 6 & 2 \\ 0 & -4 & -7 & -2\end{bmatrix}
$$

So, the answer is $4+(-4)=0.$

What is the sum of the leading entries of the $3\text{rd}$ and $4\text{th}$ rows in the matrix $A,$ given below?

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}0 & 0 & 4 & 8 \\ 0 & 0 & -8 & -8 \\ 0 & 4 & -5 & -8 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -6\end{bmatrix}
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The first non-zero entry of each row (from left to right) is the leading entry. 

Therefore, the leading entries of the $3\text{rd}$ and $4\text{th}$ rows of $A$ are $4$ and $-6$, respectively.

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}0 & 0 & 4 & 8 \\ 0 & 0 & -8 & -8 \\ 0 & 4 & -5 & -8 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -6\end{bmatrix}
$$

So, the answer is $4+(-6)=-2.$

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}0 & -1 & 1 & -7 \\ -4 & -1 & 4 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 8 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 6\end{bmatrix}
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The first non-zero entry of each row (from left to right) is the leading entry. 

Therefore, the leading entries of the $1\text{st}$ and $2\text{nd}$ rows of $A$ are $-1$ and $-4$, respectively.

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}0 & -1 & 1 & -7 \\ -4 & -1 & 4 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 8 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 6\end{bmatrix}
$$

So, the answer is $-1+(-4)=-5.$
